title: Missing records prompt Capitol probe into 15 infrastructure projects

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Cebu Provincial Government’s legal office has begun investigating 15 infrastructure projects from the previous administration after finding missing or incomplete procurement records. The projects, implemented in 2024, are being reviewed for possible referral to the National Bureau of Investigation and the Office of the Ombudsman as part of the current administration’s housekeeping efforts. Lawyer Romielyn Macalinao, assistant legal counsel of the Provincial Legal Office, said that three of the 15 projects have “completely empty” records, with no project folders or documents located so far.
